long_biography.plain_text:
In 2022, property investor Steven Scarpa bought a neglected estate in Ross, California, and set about preparing it for resale. He used workers from his construction company to overhaul its systems, renovate the kitchen and refinish the floors. Within months, the house was back on the market.

That project followed decades of larger property transactions. Scarpa's work has encompassed a substantial residential portfolio, including property in Rohnert Park, and housing developments in California. Through his wholly owned Mountain Air Enterprises, he also acquired the South Tower of Reno's former Sundowner complex.

Scarpa's work has encompassed a substantial residential portfolio, including property in Rohnert Park, and housing developments in California. Through his wholly owned Mountain Air Enterprises, he also acquired the South Tower of Reno's former Sundowner complex.
